svg.text: Intel® Agent Toolkit — Sequence diagram: one agent task, end to end
Example task: “Fix the failing unit test.” The agent loops LLM call → tool call → result until the model stops asking for tools.
2. load session state (Redis) + vector search for similar past work (pgvector)
agent loop — repeat steps 3–17 until the model replies without a tool call (cap the number of turns)
if Unsafe, guard unreachable, prompt too long or verdict unparseable → block (fail-closed)
8. bandit picks a model of that tier
bandit.update(tier, model, reward) → learns over time
12. trace: prompt, output, tokens, cost, latency, llm.model_name
controller hands over an already-running pod
17. append tool result to messages; call the LLM again
18. save session state + embedding of the outcome (long-term memory)
19. sandbox.terminate() — pool refills in the background
final answer: “test fixed — here is the diff”
Colours: blue = gateway work · green = model inference · orange = toolkit backends (this repository) · purple = telemetry · red = blocked request · grey dashed = reply.
